mapper.select: SELECT subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at FROM organization_access.subject_identity WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant (tenant_id, tenant_code, display_name, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{tenantCode}, #{displayName}, 'DISABLED', 0, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_lifecycle (tenant_id, tenant_code, display_name, initial_administrator_subject_id, status, version, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{tenantCode}, #{displayName}, #{initialAdministratorId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_membership (membership_id, tenant_id, subject_id, membership_role, status, permission_version, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{membershipId}, #{tenantId}, #{subjectId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{permissionVersion}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding (tenant_id, membership_id, role_code, bound_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{roleCode}, #{boundAt})

INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_lifecycle_outbox (event_id, tenant_id, event_type, lifecycle_status, lifecycle_version, occurred_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGED', #{status}, #{version}, #{occurredAt})
